title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a written assay separates genuine drug from substitute
summary: Seek one complete dated materia-medica or pharmacy entry that explicitly names a genuine material, a possible substitute, a concrete physical assay and opposite observed outcomes. Freeze the source's ownership of both materials, the assay operation and its result before inspecting any already admitted Herbal or Pharma target. A candidate whole reading must assign the same roles and outcome polarity; a plant name, appearance match or shared therapeutic use alone does not decide authenticity. No qualifying primary or target relation is presently established, and this proposal does not translate any form.

design.mechanism: one source-owned physical assay gives different outcomes for authentic material and named substitute
design.unit: one complete historical authenticity passage and a complete already admitted candidate record
design.contrast: operational genuine-versus-substitute distinction versus a generic two-material inventory
design.prediction: a fixed whole reading retains the two material identities, assay action and opposite results; absent an independently owned target comparison means no capacity
